item.title: ‘Normal’ Trailer: Why Can’t You People Just Let Bob Odenkirk Rest?
item.description: In director Ben Wheatley's latest, Odenkirk plays a small-town sheriff whose sense of quiet normalcy (duh) is upended by a botched bank robbery.

item.title: ‘What Genre Do You Think This Is?’: Kevin and Matthew McManus on the Delightfully Original ‘Redux Redux’
item.description: The sibling writer/directors tell IndieWire how they approached their multiverse revenge story to make it emotional, kinetic, and darkly funny.

item.title: Romance Without Limits: The Cinematography of ‘Wuthering Heights’
item.description: Director of photography Linus Sandgren and writer/director Emerald Fennell tell IndieWire about finding a visual language to bring Emily Brontë's literary classic to life.

item.title: ‘Toy Story 5’ Trailer: Woody Is Back (with a Poncho) to Take on Technology
item.description: Pixar's latest sequel in the beloved franchise, which features newcomers voiced by Greta Lee and Conan O'Brien, opens in theaters this summer.

item.title: 2026 Oscars Presenters Include Winners Adrien Brody, Mikey Madison, Zoe Saldaña, and Kieran Culkin
item.description: The Academy has tapped recent Oscar winners Adrien Brody, Mikey Madison, Zoe Saldana, and Kieran Culkin to present at the 2026 Academy Awards.

item.title: Taylor Dearden on the Speed of Filming ‘The Pitt’: ‘We Feel as Much Anxiety as the People Watching’
item.description: The actress joined IndieWire and Lavazza for a Coffee Break before the Film Independent Spirit Awards, where she was nominated for Best Supporting Performance in a New Scripted Series.

item.title: ‘Fantasy Life’ Trailer: Matthew Shear’s Delightful Comedy Is a Baumbach-Influenced Throwback
item.description: For his feature directorial debut, the "While We're Young" and "Mistress America" star melds his own experiences with some classic NYC indie spirit.

item.title: Diane Warren on Trying to Make Her Most Personal Soundtrack Song Also Her Most Universal
item.description: The 17-time Oscar nominee tells IndieWire about her latest song, "Dear Me," and how she approached writing for a movie in which she was the subject.

item.title: ‘Zootopia 2’: The Pawbert Twist, Andy Samberg, and the Big Last Minute Fix
item.description: On our podcast, the “Zootopia 2” directors discuss how animation and writing constantly inform each other throughout the five-year process, even at the very end.

item.title: Eric Dane, ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ and ‘Euphoria’ Star, Dies at 53
item.description: The TV star announced his diagnosis with ALS in 2025.
